report.summary: 3 findings survive: missing refresh_todo_snapshot in memory/__init__.py (confirmed), egress detection gap in vet.py (needs-evidence), and type-node leak in forest.py (narrowed). One finding refuted; one needs evidence but plausible.
risks: Missing refresh_todo_snapshot may cause todo list to become stale or break append_event entirely.
Missing lane_for_host in vet.py would cause MCP egress detection to fail silently, allowing tools to make network calls without being flagged.
Type nodes leaking into file layers could corrupt reachability analysis and produce incorrect module classifications.
todos: Define refresh_todo_snapshot in daedalus/memory/__init__.py or import it from existing module.
Add lane_for_host to daedalus/tools/vet.py if missing, or verify it is imported/defined elsewhere.
Add _is_type_node_id filter in build_forest_hierarchy in daedalus/structcore/forest.py to prevent type node leakage.

items.title: Define refresh_todo_snapshot in daedalus/memory/__init__.py
items.why_now: The function is called but not defined, which will raise a NameError at runtime, breaking append_event and any caller that writes to memory.

steps.do: Add function definition for refresh_todo_snapshot that reads TODO_PATH, appends new event, and writes back. Alternatively, import it from the correct module if it exists elsewhere.
steps.verified_by: Run tests/test_memstore.py::test_append_load_fold_roundtrip and confirm pass; also run test_agent_env.py::test_done_events_close_matching_todos.

items.assumption: The function should read the existing todo file, append a new entry derived from the event, and write it back. The exact logic is not specified; assume it follows the pattern of other snapshot functions in the codebase.

items.title: Fix missing lane_for_host in daedalus/tools/vet.py
items.why_now: If lane_for_host is not defined or imported, MCP egress detection will fail, allowing tools to make network calls without being flagged as egress.

steps.do: Search the full vet.py for 'lane_for_host' definition or import. If missing, add import from correct module (likely daedalus/adapters/transport.py or daedalus/providers/base.py) or define the function locally.

items.assumption: The function lane_for_host exists elsewhere in the codebase; the assumption is that it is defined in daedalus/adapters/transport.py or similar. If not, need to implement it.

items.title: Add _is_type_node_id filter in build_forest_hierarchy in daedalus/structcore/forest.py
items.why_now: Without this filter, type nodes may leak into file layers, potentially corrupting reachability analysis and producing incorrect module classifications.

steps.do: In build_forest_hierarchy, after building hyperedges, filter out any node that matches _is_type_node_id from the file layer.

items.assumption: The function _is_type_node_id is already defined in forest.py and works correctly; the fix is to ensure it is called in build_forest_hierarchy.
